question: What Are the Insulation Classes of a Motor?
body_html:
Motor insulation class is the letter on the nameplate that sets the maximum winding temperature the insulation can withstand. The four standard classes are A, B, F and H.

ClassMax TemperatureAllowable Rise at 40°C Ambient
A105°C60°C
B130°C80°C
F155°C105°C
H180°C125°C

Every 10°C above the rated limit roughly halves insulation life.
